findings.evidence: Online discovery using queries: "Urant 1.0.1.2-urant-p1R-auto firmware", "1.0.1.2-urant-p1R-auto" firmware, "1.0.1.2-urant-p1R-auto" returned no official vendor firmware repositories or support portals.
